cdp - attach to the Chrome/Electron tab you already have

Usage: cdp <command> [args]

  help [command]                    Survivor card; leftover verbs still have topic help

  doctor / ready [--format json]
  list|tabs|ls [--format json]
  open [url] [--perceive] [--attach-timeout-ms N] [--ready-timeout-ms N] [--ready-selector sel] [--reuse-url] [--format json]
  nav <target> <url> [--perceive] [--format json] [--qa|--summary] [--compact]
  perceive <target> [flags] [--format json]
  text <target> [selector|--auto]
  click <target> <sel|@ref|name> [--js|-j] [--format json] [--qa|--summary]
  fill <target> <sel|@ref> <txt> [--format json]
  press|key <target> <key> [--format json]
  select <target> <selector> <val> [--format json]
  scroll <target> <dir|x,y|to top|to bottom> [px] [--scroll-container SELECTOR] [--format json] [--qa|--summary] [--compact]
  eval <target> <expr>
  inject <target> <flag> [content]
  cascade <target> <sel|@ref> [prop] [--format json]
  waitfor <target> <selector> [ms]
  dismiss-modal <target>
  elshot <target> <sel|@ref>
  shot <target> [file|--annotate]
  spawn-debug-browser [browser] [--port N] [--url URL] [--profile-dir DIR] [--exe PATH] [--format json]
  stop [target] [--format json]

Flags (not product names): click --js is JS click; eval --b64 is base64.
Unique off-screen click names scrollIntoView if off-screen.
perceive -C -d 8 for structure/@refs; -x <sel> / --exclude drops chrome.
text --auto for what the page says.

Chrome 136: default profile cannot enable CDP. Persistent non-default daily dir or isolated spawn; ask first.
Electron: CDP_PORT=9333 (not 9222).

cdp help <command> prints leftover topic help.

  Strategy: suggest-command
  Run: cdp perceive

  Strategy: show-help
  Run: cdp help list
  Reason: The command received an unknown flag or argument. Print usage instead of probing doctor/status.
Next: cdp help list

Error: format must be text or json
Recovery:
  Kind: unknown
  Strategy: run-doctor
  Run: cdp doctor
  Reason: The failure was not classified; check browser setup and available targets.
Next: cdp doctor

Error: target ID required. Run "cdp list" first.
Recovery:
  Kind: target-resolution
  Strategy: rediscover-target
  Run: cdp list  # if empty: cdp open https://example.com
  Then: cdp open https://example.com
  Reason: The requested tab target could not be resolved from the current page list.
